subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: After the branch is cleanly mergeable, should the Automations feature and the folded-in Skills follow-up remain one landing unit?
rationale: The PR deliberately combines a large new mobile feature with fixes from an already merged Skills PR; deciding whether that combined native-app scope is acceptable is an ownership and merge-risk choice rather than a mechanical correctness repair.

options.title: Keep Combined Scope
options.body: Review and land the Automations and Skills follow-up changes together after exact-head checks and conflict resolution.

options.title: Split Skills Follow-Up
options.body: Move the Skills-only corrections into a narrow follow-up and keep this PR focused on Automations parity.

options.title: Pause Landing
options.body: Hold the PR until native app owners confirm the desired product and ownership boundary for the combined change.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Scope
recommendation.body: Review and land the Automations and Skills follow-up changes together after exact-head checks and conflict resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to both the merged Skills parity work and the current Automations implementation, making them the best evidenced routing candidate despite incomplete local history inspection.
